title: Reactive Resource Layer
description: Formalize the data sync lifecycle into a unified resource abstraction with reactive FRB streams, state vector exchange for CRDTs, high-water mark sync for chat, and an iroh custom transport replacing the WebSocket relay.

phases.description: Define the Resource trait, ResourceKind, Visibility, Priority, and concrete implementations for all four resource types. Create ResourceRegistry. Refactor topics.rs to derive from Resource impls.
acceptance_criteria: Resource trait defined with id(), kind(), visibility(), topic(), topic_string(), priority()
FestivalState, GroupState, GroupChat, StageChat implement Resource
ResourceRegistry can register/deregister/sort by priority
Existing topic derivation functions still produce the same TopicIds
All existing tests pass unchanged

phases.task_name: CRDT sync protocol — state vector exchange
phases.description: Replace gossip_log-based catchup for CRDT resources with Yrs state vector exchange. Add sv_exchange WS message type to DO. Delete client-side gossip_log and topic_sync_state for CRDT resources.
acceptance_criteria: DO holds Yrs docs in yrs_docs table, computes diffs on sv_exchange request
Client sends state vector on connect, receives single diff blob
subscribe-first-then-exchange ordering: no gap, dupes are Yrs no-ops
topic_sync_state table deleted from client schema
gossip_log no longer used for CRDT resources (still used for chat)
Two-node integration test: D1 modifies festival state offline, D2 catches up via SV exchange

phases.description: Add writer_seq to chat messages. Implement ChatStateVector-based catchup. Add chat_catchup WS message type to DO. Replace sinceSeq-based catchup for chat.
acceptance_criteria: ChatMessage type has writer_seq field (monotonic per user per topic)
ChatStateVector = HashMap<UserId, u64> computed from local SQLite
DO responds to chat_catchup with messages not covered by client's ChatStateVector, newest first
INSERT OR IGNORE handles duplicates from HWM overlap
sinceSeq-based catchup removed from ws_relay.rs
gossip_log table deleted from client schema (no longer needed for any resource)

phases.description: Implement SyncOrchestrator that runs subscribe→catch-up→live for all registered resources in priority order. Wire into OffbeatNode. Simplify gossip_manager to just subscribe/broadcast.
acceptance_criteria: SyncOrchestrator processes resources in priority order on peer connect
gossip_manager.rs stripped to: subscribe, unsubscribe, broadcast (< 100 lines of non-test code)
GossipMessage enum removed (raw Yrs diffs + encrypted chat messages only)
GossipWireMessage, encode_gossip_message, decode_wire_message deleted
dispatch_message replaced by Resource-driven dispatch
All existing functionality preserved (two-device manual test)

phases.description: Replace pull-based bridge API with Stream<T> per resource. Dart gets typed streams. Writes mutate locally and queue for gossip. Delete per-entity DTO boilerplate where possible.
acceptance_criteria: watch_lineup(festival_id) returns Stream<LineupDto>
watch_group_state(group_id) returns Stream<GroupStateDto>
watch_chat(topic, last_n) returns Stream<Vec<ChatMessageDto>>
watch_sync_status() returns Stream<SyncStatusDto>
Write commands (check_in, toggle_star, send_chat) mutate locally and emit on stream before gossip delivery
Bridge mod.rs reduced from ~840 lines to < 400
FRB codegen succeeds

phases.description: Replace all pull-based data fetching in Flutter with StreamBuilder subscriptions. Remove manual refresh patterns. Services become thin wrappers.
acceptance_criteria: Zero pull-based data fetching in Flutter screens
All screens use StreamBuilder or equivalent reactive pattern
UI updates within one frame of local state change
Flutter analyze passes with no errors

phases.description: Replace ws_relay.rs with an iroh custom transport that speaks WebSocket to the DO. The DO becomes a peer in iroh's transport hierarchy. Delete manual reconnect and seq tracking.
acceptance_criteria: ws_relay.rs deleted
New ws_transport.rs implements iroh custom transport traits
WebSocket frames carry iroh datagrams
iroh handles reconnect (no manual backoff/jitter code)
DO reachable as a peer via Endpoint with custom transport
Two-device sync works end-to-end via DO relay

phases.description: Delete dead code, consolidate boilerplate tests into tests against the Resource abstraction, verify all metrics.
acceptance_criteria: gossip_manager.rs < 100 lines of non-test code
db/mod.rs < 300 lines
Bridge mod.rs < 400 lines
No dead code warnings from clippy
All tests pass
Test count reduced but coverage maintained
